description: Source code for network communication handling in the Wesnoth game, including connection management, socket operations, and data transmission.

classes.name: connection_details
classes.description: Stores details of a network connection, including socket, host, port, handle, and statistics.

classes.name: schema_pair
classes.description: Holds compression schemas for incoming and outgoing data.

classes.name: connect_operation
classes.description: Handles asynchronous connection attempts to a host.

classes.name: error
classes.description: Represents network errors, with ability to disconnect.

classes.name: manager
classes.description: Manages network sockets, threads, and connections.

classes.name: server_manager
classes.description: Handles server socket initialization and acceptance of incoming connections.

methods.name: create_connection
methods.description: Creates a new connection record and returns its handle.

methods.name: get_connection_details
methods.description: Retrieves connection details by handle.

methods.name: get_socket
methods.description: Returns the socket associated with a connection handle.

methods.name: remove_connection
methods.description: Removes a connection record.

methods.name: is_pending_remote_handle
methods.description: Checks if a connection is pending remote handle assignment.

methods.name: set_remote_handle
methods.description: Assigns a remote handle to a connection.

methods.name: check_error
methods.description: Detects socket errors and throws exceptions.

methods.name: connection_stats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a connection.

methods.name: get_connection_stats
methods.description: Returns stats for a specific connection.

methods.name: error::error
methods.description: Constructs an error object with message and socket.

methods.name: error::disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the socket associated with the error.

methods.name: manager::manager
methods.description: Initializes network manager, setting up socket set and threads.

methods.name: manager::~manager
methods.description: Cleans up network resources.

methods.name: server_manager::server_manager
methods.description: Initializes server socket on specified port.

methods.name: server_manager::~server_manager
methods.description: Closes server socket.

methods.name: connect_operation::run
methods.description: Performs the connection process, including socket setup and handshake.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a host and port.

methods.name: accept_connection
methods.description: Accepts incoming connection requests and performs handshake.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects a connection handle.

methods.name: queue_disconnect
methods.description: Queues a connection for disconnection.

methods.name: receive_data
methods.description: Receives data from a connection, with optional timeout.

methods.name: send_data
methods.description: Sends data over a connection, with compression and size management.

methods.name: queue_data
methods.description: Queues data to be sent over a connection.

methods.name: send_data_all_except
methods.description: Sends data to all connections except one.

methods.name: ip_address
methods.description: Returns the IP address of a connection as string.

methods.name: get_send_stats
methods.description: Returns current send statistics for a connection.

methods.name: get_receive_stats
methods.description: Returns current receive statistics for a connection.
